correctness.rationale: For every k>=2, exact integer-valued polynomial interpolation gives D(k)|k+1. For p^a||k+1, the source’s proved Lemma 9 settles the zero case a<=t. For a>t, Kummer carries below a and above a+t bound every coefficient valuation below by a-t, while the explicit q=p or q=1+p^a(b-p^t) attains a-t; all boundary inequalities and digit-sum identities are verified symbolically. Independent exact integer checks cover direct gcd k<=160, full p-adic minima through n<=1200, and all explicit witnesses through n<12001.

value.rationale: The 2026 source proves the nontriviality criterion for a natural OEIS-indexed binomial progression gcd but leaves all positive p-adic multiplicities unspecified. The complete explicit prime-power factorization is the most natural quantitative strengthening of this invariant. It distinguishes gcd values with identical prime support (such as 2,4,8), gives exact constructive minimizing witnesses, and exposes a two-scale carry law; it is not a renaming, an arbitrary finite computation, or a trivial restatement of a binary criterion.
